data.label: sensor-runs
data.sensorReads: the spine on Loki: sensor.run.ended events whose outcome is red or unmeasured, per sensor and owner, over 75 minutes
data.sensorQuery: sum by (sensor, owner) (count_over_time({job="platform-chorus", appName="chorus-events"} |= "sensor.run.ended" | json | outcome=~"red|unmeasured" [75m]))
